title: The long fight to return the 'Ségou treasure,' a spoil of colonization
subhead: The Sufi spiritual leader El Hadj Omar Tall, who counted hundreds of thousands of followers, was a 19th-century scholar and anti-colonialist fighter. France's adoption of a law on the restitution of stolen cultural property could allow his descendants to recover his manuscripts, jewelry, and valuable possessions.

subhead: Jean-Jacques Muyembe reflects on the current spread of the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo. In just three months, the death toll has nearly reached that of the 2018 epidemic, which lasted 22 months.

title: Ugandan opponent Bobi Wine: 'The president's son has given a public order for me to be killed'
subhead: As the Ugandan authorities prepared to arrest him, singer Bobi Wine fled to Washington in March. Speaking to Le Monde, he recounted his two-month flight and the current state of the opposition in the East African country.

title: Anna Wintour and André Leon Talley's sudden break
subhead: 'Sewn and torn' (3/6). Love stories and friendships can sometimes end badly, even in the world of fashion. For nearly 40 years, the fashion journalist accompanied the rise of the woman who would become the all-powerful and influential editor-in-chief of 'Vogue.' Until he fell out of favor.
